behavior: An expanded `Combobox.Input` or `Autocomplete.Input` names in `aria-controls` only the id that the list element has now. It has no `aria-controls` while the list has an empty `id`. The input, and a `Combobox.Trigger` or `Autocomplete.Trigger` beside it, follow each change of the `id` of the list. Base UI renders `aria-controls=""` on the input for a list with an empty `id`. Base UI reads the `id` of the list when the root or the trigger renders, so after a change of the `id` they name the old id until they render again.
